service_jobs.problem_description: Screen touch not responding in bottom third.
service_jobs.diagnosis: Microscope inspection confirmed loose digitizer solder pin.
service_jobs.repair_notes: Re-soldered pin 14 on FPC connector.

service_jobs.problem_description: No Power, completely unresponsive to charging.
service_jobs.diagnosis: VCC_MAIN short to ground caused by cracked ceramic decoupling capacitor near PMIC.
service_jobs.repair_notes: Removed shorted capacitor under microscope. Cleaned solder pads and re-flowed power rail.

service_jobs.problem_description: Dropped in swimming pool. Shuts off immediately after Samsung logo.
service_jobs.diagnosis: Corrosion under primary Power Management IC (PMIC). Replacement IC required.
service_jobs.repair_notes: Ultrasonic board clean completed. Ordered original PMIC chip from vendor.

service_jobs.problem_description: Backlight turns off when display lid opened past 90 degrees.
service_jobs.diagnosis: Dustgate stress fracture on eDP embedded display port ribbon flex.
service_jobs.repair_notes: Inspecting with microscope to prepare micro-jumper wiring.

service_jobs.problem_description: Battery pouch swelling pushing up trackpad.
service_jobs.diagnosis: Severely degraded lithium polymer cell pack. Urgent replacement needed.
service_jobs.repair_notes: Safely extracted swollen battery. Installed genuine 86Wh Dell pack.
service_jobs.completion_notes: System stress test passed. Thermals stable. Device ready for pickup.

service_jobs.problem_description: USB-C charging connector loose. Only charges at certain angle.
service_jobs.diagnosis: Damaged internal center pin block inside USB-C receptacle.
service_jobs.repair_notes: Replaced USB-C daughterboard module with OEM component.
service_jobs.completion_notes: Tested 30W Power Delivery and display video output. Full charging speed restored.

service_jobs.problem_description: Intermittent charging and loose cable fit.
service_jobs.diagnosis: USB-C flex sub-board damaged.
service_jobs.repair_notes: Disassembled phone and replacing sub-board.

service_jobs.diagnosis: Outer glass separation and OCA refurbishing.
service_jobs.repair_notes: Separated broken outer glass on heated vacuum platform. Laminated new 9H tempered glass lens.
service_jobs.completion_notes: Screen tested, touch sensitivity 100%. Ready for customer collection.

service_jobs.diagnosis: Camera protective bezel scratch.
service_jobs.repair_notes: Replaced sapphire glass bezel.
